archetypes.name: contract-matrix
archetypes.rationale: The plan changes a shared driver contract across multiple prompt and reference call sites, making rc-arm and caller drift likely.
archetypes.prompt_body: Map the proposed --with-plan-size exit-code contract against every listed caller and retained standalone path. Look for mismatches in rc 10/11/12/13 handling, Override behavior, Split Refine returns, and ${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"} threading across SKILL.md and the referenced approval/discussion/flags docs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sentinel-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The plan relies on preserving legacy completion sentinels while removing a standalone Step 2b.5 clean-path call.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace ownership of .completed/step-2b and .completed/step-2b.5 through initial clean paths, validator defects, Override, Gate B, discussion-round2, Gate A re-entry, and hard/partition Split Refine returns. Hunt for missing writes, duplicate/conflicting writes, or branches where the plan says a sentinel is preserved but no scoped file update or structural assertion would enforce it. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: stream-contract
archetypes.rationale: The merged script changes stdout, FD3, result-env, WARN, quiet-mode, and legacy non-flag behavior in one place.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the proposed display/KV stream discipline for design-postplan-emit.sh and check-plan-size.sh integration. Compare --with-plan-size behavior against the legacy non-flag contract, focusing on FD3 output, .design-postplan-emit-result.env keys, WARN display without WARN= leakage, quiet-mode capture, and rc1 diagnostic preservation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-contract
archetypes.rationale: The acceptance criteria depend heavily on shell harnesses pinning prompt contracts and edge branches after a mechanical consolidation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate whether the planned tests and structural pins actually cover every changed contract, especially defects-priority, partition/hard precedence, pause rc 11, nonfatal plan-size rc 2/3 logging, classification WARN preservation, retained standalone callers, and stale ordering pins. Look for assertions that are too broad, too brittle, or missing for cross-file prompt/doc consistency. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
